## `outsourcing_facts` — 委外收发事实

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Fact / 事实 |
| 用途 | 保存委外发料和委外回货的真实发生记录。 |
| 明确不负责 | 委外合同表达承诺，本表过账才产生真实库存 OUT 或 IN。 |

| 写入边界 | OperationalFactUsecase 从委外订单或 WIP 来源创建、过账和取消。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>outsourcing_facts_quantity_positive</code>

```sql
quantity > 0
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_sku_subject_allowed</code>

```sql
product_sku_id IS NULL OR subject_type = 'PRODUCT'
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_status_audit_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'POSTED'
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND ((posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL)
      OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL)))
)
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_subject_allowed</code>

```sql
subject_type IN ('MATERIAL', 'PRODUCT')
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_type_allowed</code>

```sql
fact_type IN ('MATERIAL_ISSUE', 'RETURN_RECEIPT')
```

- <code>outsourcing_facts_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

- <code>outsourcing_order_items_subject_exactly_one</code>

```sql
((subject_type = 'PRODUCT' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND material_id IS NULL) OR (subject_type = 'MATERIAL' AND product_id IS NULL AND material_id IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>outsourcing_order_items_subject_type_allowed</code>

```sql
subject_type IN ('PRODUCT', 'MATERIAL')
```

- <code>outsourcing_order_items_unit_price_non_negative</code>

```sql
unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0
```

| <code>productionexceptiondecision_decision_no</code> | 是 | <code>decision_no</code> | — |
| <code>productionexceptiondecision_decision_type_status_execution_status_requested_at</code> | 否 | <code>decision_type</code>, <code>status</code>, <code>execution_status</code>, <code>requested_at</code> | — |
| <code>productionexceptiondecision_production_order_id_production_order_item_id</code> | 否 | <code>production_order_id</code>, <code>production_order_item_id</code> | — |
| <code>productionexceptiondecision_quality_inspection_id</code> | 是 | <code>quality_inspection_id</code> | <code>((decision_type = &#39;SCRAP&#39; OR decision_type = &#39;WIP_CONCESSION&#39;) AND (status = &#39;SUBMITTED&#39; OR status = &#39;APPROVED&#39;))</code> |
| <code>productionexceptiondecision_requested_by_idempotency_key</code> | 是 | <code>requested_by</code>, <code>idempotency_key</code> | — |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_exception_decisions_execution_allowed</code>

```sql
execution_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPLIED', 'REVERSED')
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_execution_audit</code>

```sql
(
  (execution_status = 'PENDING' AND executed_at IS NULL AND executed_by IS NULL AND execution_reason IS NULL AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR (execution_status = 'APPLIED' AND executed_at IS NOT NULL AND executed_by IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(execution_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND reversed_at IS NULL AND reversed_by IS NULL AND reverse_reason IS NULL)
  OR (execution_status = 'REVERSED'
    AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversed_by IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reverse_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND ((decision_type = 'OVER_ISSUE' AND executed_at IS NULL AND executed_by IS NULL AND execution_reason IS NULL)
      OR (decision_type IN ('SCRAP', 'WIP_CONCESSION') AND executed_at IS NOT NULL AND executed_by IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(execution_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)))
)
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_intent_bundle</code>

```sql
length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(idempotency_payload_hash) = 64
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_quantity_positive</code>

```sql
requested_quantity > 0 AND (approved_quantity IS NULL OR approved_quantity > 0)
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_source_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (decision_type = 'OVER_ISSUE' AND production_material_requirement_id IS NOT NULL AND production_wip_batch_id IS NULL AND quality_inspection_id IS NULL)
  OR
  (decision_type IN ('SCRAP', 'WIP_CONCESSION') AND production_material_requirement_id IS NULL AND production_wip_batch_id IS NOT NULL AND quality_inspection_id IS NOT NULL)
)
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_type_allowed</code>

```sql
decision_type IN ('SCRAP', 'OVER_ISSUE', 'WIP_CONCESSION')
```

- <code>production_exception_decisions_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_facts_quantity_positive</code>

```sql
quantity > 0
```

- <code>production_facts_sku_subject_allowed</code>

```sql
product_sku_id IS NULL OR subject_type = 'PRODUCT'
```

- <code>production_facts_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'POSTED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_facts_status_audit_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'POSTED'
    AND posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL
    AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
    AND ((posted_at IS NULL AND posted_by IS NULL)
      OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by IS NOT NULL)))
)
```

- <code>production_facts_subject_allowed</code>

```sql
subject_type IN ('MATERIAL', 'PRODUCT')
```

- <code>production_facts_type_allowed</code>

```sql
fact_type IN ('MATERIAL_ISSUE', 'FINISHED_GOODS_RECEIPT', 'REWORK')
```

- <code>production_facts_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

- <code>production_facts_wip_source_allowed</code>

```sql
production_wip_batch_id IS NULL OR (fact_type = 'FINISHED_GOODS_RECEIPT' AND source_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND source_line_id IS NOT NULL)
```

- <code>production_order_events_command_allowed</code>

```sql
command_key IN ('CREATE', 'SAVE', 'RELEASE', 'CLOSE', 'CANCEL')
```

- <code>production_order_events_contract_v1</code>

```sql
result_contract = 'production.order-mutation-result/v1'
```

- <code>production_order_events_create_shape</code>

```sql
(
  (command_key = 'CREATE' AND from_status IS NULL AND to_status = 'DRAFT' AND order_version = 1)
  OR
  (command_key <> 'CREATE' AND from_status IS NOT NULL)
)
```

- <code>production_order_events_from_status_allowed</code>

```sql
from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('DRAFT', 'RELEASED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_order_events_hash_length</code>

```sql
length(intent_hash) = 64
```

- <code>production_order_events_key_present</code>

```sql
length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
```

- <code>production_order_events_reason_scope</code>

```sql
(
  (
  command_key NOT IN ('CLOSE', 'CANCEL') AND reason IS NULL
)
OR
(
  command_key = 'CLOSE'
)
OR
(
  command_key = 'CANCEL' AND reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
  )
)
```

- <code>production_order_events_to_status_allowed</code>

```sql
to_status IN ('DRAFT', 'RELEASED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_order_events_version_positive</code>

```sql
order_version > 0
```

| <code>productionorderoperation_production_order_item_id_step_no</code> | 是 | <code>production_order_item_id</code>, <code>step_no</code> | — |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_order_operations_business_confirmation_scope</code>

```sql
(
  (operation_code = 'PACKAGING' AND business_confirmation_code = 'PACKAGING_MATERIAL')
  OR (operation_code <> 'PACKAGING' AND business_confirmation_code IS NULL)
)
```

- <code>production_order_operations_execution_supported</code>

```sql
inhouse_allowed OR outsourcing_allowed
```

- <code>production_order_operations_operation_present</code>

```sql
length(trim(operation_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
```

- <code>production_order_operations_order_positive</code>

```sql
production_order_id > 0
```

- <code>production_order_operations_output_code_present</code>

```sql
length(trim(output_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
```

- <code>production_order_operations_process_name_present</code>

```sql
length(trim(process_name_snapshot)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
```

- <code>production_order_operations_process_positive</code>

```sql
process_id > 0
```

- <code>production_order_operations_quantity_positive</code>

```sql
planned_quantity > 0
```

- <code>production_order_operations_route_fixed</code>

```sql
route_code = 'PLUSH_SEW_HAND_V1' AND route_version = 1
```

- <code>production_order_operations_route_step_fixed</code>

```sql
(
  (step_no = 10 AND operation_code = 'FABRIC_PROCESSING' AND output_code = 'CUT_PIECE' AND NOT inhouse_allowed AND outsourcing_allowed)
  OR (step_no = 20 AND operation_code = 'SEWING' AND output_code = 'SHELL' AND inhouse_allowed AND outsourcing_allowed)
  OR (step_no = 30 AND operation_code = 'HANDWORK' AND output_code = 'FINISHED_GOODS' AND inhouse_allowed AND outsourcing_allowed)
  OR (step_no = 40 AND operation_code = 'PACKAGING' AND output_code = 'PACKED_GOODS' AND inhouse_allowed AND NOT outsourcing_allowed)
)
```

- <code>production_order_operations_step_positive</code>

```sql
step_no > 0
```

## `production_orders` — 生产订单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存生产承诺、计划日期、产品行及来源销售订单或 BOM 引用。 |
| 明确不负责 | 发布只冻结生产输入并初始化正式路线/WIP，不等于领料、完工、入库或财务事实。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | DRAFT 转 RELEASED，再 CLOSED；DRAFT 或 RELEASED 可在事实门禁允许时 CANCELLED；禁止物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | ProductionOrderUsecase 创建和保存草稿，通过命名动作发布、关闭和取消。 |

| <code>order_no</code> | <code>varchar(64)</code> | <code>string</code> | 非空 | — | — | 业务编号；唯一性和生成规则见索引与领域 usecase。 |

| <code>cancel_reason</code> | <code>varchar(255)</code> | <code>string</code> | 可空 | — | — | 业务含义以字段名、表用途、约束和链接的 schema/usecase 为准。 |

| 索引 | 唯一 | 字段 | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>productionorder_created_by_created_at</code> | 否 | <code>created_by</code>, <code>created_at</code> | — |
| <code>productionorder_order_no</code> | 是 | <code>order_no</code> | — |
| <code>productionorder_planned_end_at</code> | 否 | <code>planned_end_at</code> | — |
| <code>productionorder_status_planned_start_at</code> | 否 | <code>status</code>, <code>planned_start_at</code> | — |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_orders_cancel_actor_pair</code>

```sql
((cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>production_orders_cancel_reason_present</code>

```sql
status <> 'CANCELLED' OR (cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
```

- <code>production_orders_cancel_reason_scope</code>

```sql
cancel_reason IS NULL OR status = 'CANCELLED'
```

- <code>production_orders_close_actor_pair</code>

```sql
((closed_by IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL) OR (closed_by IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>production_orders_close_reason_scope</code>

```sql
close_reason IS NULL OR status = 'CLOSED'
```

- <code>production_orders_lifecycle_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (status = 'DRAFT'
    AND released_by IS NULL AND released_at IS NULL
    AND closed_by IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
    AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'RELEASED'
    AND released_by IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NOT NULL
    AND closed_by IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
    AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CLOSED'
    AND released_by IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NOT NULL
    AND closed_by IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL)
  OR
  (status = 'CANCELLED'
    AND closed_by IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
    AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)
)
```

- <code>production_orders_order_no_present</code>

```sql
length(trim(order_no)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
```

- <code>production_orders_planned_dates_ordered</code>

```sql
planned_start_at IS NULL OR planned_end_at IS NULL OR planned_end_at >= planned_start_at
```

- <code>production_orders_release_actor_pair</code>

```sql
((released_by IS NULL AND released_at IS NULL) OR (released_by IS NOT NULL AND released_at IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>production_orders_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('DRAFT', 'RELEASED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_orders_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

| <code>note</code> | <code>varchar(255)</code> | <code>string</code> | 可空 | — | — | 业务备注；不替代状态原因、审批意见或正式审计字段。 |
| <code>created_at</code> | <code>timestamp with time zone</code> | <code>time.Time</code> | 非空 | — | — | 记录创建时间；大量表由 Ent client 的 Go 侧默认值赋值，不应据此推断数据库存在 DEFAULT。 |

| <code>production_order_id</code> | <code>bigint</code> | <code>int</code> | 非空 | — | — | 外键，关联 `production_orders`。 |
| <code>production_order_item_id</code> | <code>bigint</code> | <code>int</code> | 非空 | — | 列级唯一 | 外键，关联 `production_order_items`。 |
| <code>confirmed_by</code> | <code>bigint</code> | <code>int</code> | 可空 | — | — | 外键，关联 `admin_users`。 |

| <code>production_packaging_confirmations_production_order_items_packaging_confirmation</code> | <code>production_order_item_id</code> | [<code>public.production_order_items</code>](生产与委外.md#table-production-order-items) <code>id</code> | 未显式指定（PostgreSQL 默认 NO ACTION） | <code>NO ACTION</code> |

### 索引

| 索引 | 唯一 | 字段 | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>productionpackagingconfirmation_production_order_id_status</code> | 否 | <code>production_order_id</code>, <code>status</code> | — |
| <code>productionpackagingconfirmation_production_order_item_id_confirmation_idempotency_key</code> | 是 | <code>production_order_item_id</code>, <code>confirmation_idempotency_key</code> | <code>confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL</code> |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_packaging_confirmations_actor_bundle</code>

```sql
(
  (
    status = 'PENDING'
    AND confirmed_by IS NULL
    AND confirmed_at IS NULL
    AND packaging_version_snapshot IS NULL
    AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NULL
    AND confirmation_intent_hash IS NULL
  )
  OR
  (
    status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL
    AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND packaging_version_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim(packaging_version_snapshot)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
    AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim(confirmation_idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
    AND confirmation_intent_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND length(confirmation_intent_hash) = 64
  )
)
```

- <code>production_packaging_confirmations_order_positive</code>

```sql
production_order_id > 0
```

- <code>production_packaging_confirmations_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
```

- <code>production_packaging_confirmations_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

### CHECK 约束

- <code>production_wip_batches_execution_allowed</code>

```sql
execution_mode IS NULL OR execution_mode IN ('IN_HOUSE', 'OUTSOURCED')
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_flow_type_allowed</code>

```sql
flow_type IN ('NORMAL', 'REWORK')
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_order_positive</code>

```sql
production_order_id > 0
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_quantity_positive</code>

```sql
quantity > 0
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_rework_bundle</code>

```sql
((flow_type = 'NORMAL' AND rework_reason IS NULL) OR (flow_type = 'REWORK' AND rework_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(rework_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND (source_batch_id IS NOT NULL OR origin_rework_fact_id IS NOT NULL)))
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('PLANNED', 'SPLIT', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'OUTSOURCED', 'WAITING_QUALITY', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
```

- <code>production_wip_batches_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `production_wip_events` — 在制品事件回执

| 项目 | 说明 |

| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | 只追加、不可修改、不可删除。 |
| 写入边界 | Production WIP repo 在 ApplyProductionWIPCommand 事务内写入。 |
